notes.title: ToHeart
notes.notes:
[h2]ToHeart is coming to Steam![/h2]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3380520/ToHeart/

The late-'90s landmark visual novel from AQUAPLUS is back and fully remastered with 3D scenes and animations, full HD resolution, the choice between the original cast or all-new voiceovers, and international translations for the first time ever!

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45315736/9ac1546e610f5f9b641cfb17b8f8b0161a39cc8e.png[/img]

The [i]AQUAPAZZA[/i] roster also features two [i]ToHeart[/i] heroines: the maid robot MULTI, who is a full playable character, and the rich girl witch SERIKA KURUSUGAWA, who appears as a partner! The Steam release of [i]AQUAPAZZA[/i] is also planned for 2025.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3229260/AQUAPAZZA_Aquaplus_Dream_Match/
